Gift from friends in San Francisco, 2016

In 2016, when I decided to move to Italy, my friends in San Francisco gave me this hand calligraphy piece that simply said yes. It represented my motto at the time — just say yes — which led me to so many beautiful experiences.

It’s sometimes hard to remember to do that. But it really opened me up to incredible adventures.
